LanguageData.RoyalThrumbo.label: royal thrumbo
LanguageData.RoyalThrumbo.description: These majestic creatures have been named royal thrumbos by rimworld residents who have encountered them. Even more rarely seen than a regular thrumbo, their porcelain-like horns fetch an absurd price from rarity collectors. Royal thrumbos also have luxurious fur that grows out slowly but can be sheared into a valuable wool, and they also produce an exotic milk that is a rare delicacy.
